Am I helping them transform or just getting them to buy?
Is the urgency real or manufactured?

sequence.email: Who we are, what to expect, first value delivery
Quick Win framework or signature method
Soft intro to core offer or natural next step

sequence.phase: Seed content, curiosity building, mechanism preview
Invitation, mechanism deep-dive, proof, FAQ handling
Urgency (real deadline), scarcity (real limits), final call

sequence.monthly_rhythm: 3 pure value emails, 1 contextual offer mention

framework.name: Mechanism First

structure.element: Problem acknowledgment (they already know the pain)
Mechanism reveal (THIS is what makes our solution different)

framework.voice: Consultative, not salesy; educational, not pitchy

structure.element: Each email ends on cliffhanger or open loop
Story continues in next email (drives opens)
Natural integration of offer into narrative
Resolution tied to transformation, not just purchase
Core transformation (what changes in their life)
Primary mechanism (the method that drives change)
Bonuses that accelerate (not distract from) core outcome
Guarantee that removes risk without inviting abuse

voice_guidelines.tone: Confident but not arrogant, helpful but not servile
voice_guidelines.rhythm: Short sentences for impact, longer for explanation, variety for engagement

vocabulary.use: Transformation, breakthrough, milestone, mechanism, resonance, Applied Inspiration
vocabulary.avoid: Crushing it, killing it, game-changer, revolutionary, secret, hack

example.context_summary: 90-day transformation program designed, mechanism = Fast Track System, price = $997
example.required_inputs: Product name, core transformation, mechanism, milestones, support tier
example.expected_outputs: Complete sales page with headline, mechanism section, value stack, FAQ
example.success_criteria: Sales page passes Heart Test, clearly explains mechanism, addresses objections

example.readiness_level: All skills ready to escalate to L2 if called

heart_test.criteria: Would I be proud to show this communication to someone I deeply respect?
Does this build long-term trust or optimize for short-term extraction?
Am I helping them transform or just getting them to act?
Is the urgency/scarcity real and ethical, or manufactured?
Would this still work if they could see all my internal reasoning?

anti_patterns.pattern: Using shame or FOMO to drive action
Overwhelming with volume instead of clarity

message_refinement.source: Real user responses and engagement data
message_refinement.metrics: Open rates, click rates, conversion, testimonials, Heart Test feedback

voice_consistency.maintain: Core messaging framework, Heart Test standards, transformation focus
voice_consistency.evolve: Tactical language, examples, story selection based on what resonates
voice_consistency.preserve: Authenticity, ethical standards, long-term relationship building
